items.title: 2.2 Computational thinking se masla hal karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: topic 2.2 with its Do You Know? box (printed page 21, read from a second copy of the book; not in this scan).

blocks.text: Computational thinking se masla hal karna (problem solving) hamein masle logical (mantiqi) aur munazzam (organized, tarteeb wale) tareeqe se hal karne mein madad deta hai. Is se ghaltiyan aur uljhan (confusion) kam hoti hain. Computational thinking masla hal karne ki overall (majmooi) salahiyat behtar banati hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Jab insaan computational thinking istemal karte hain to computer bhi masle usi tarah hal karte hain, bas bohat tez!

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Section 2.2 masla hal karne ke chaar qadam batata hai, har aik ki apni sub-heading hai: (1) masle ko saaf pehchanna (Identifying a Problem Clearly), (2) masle ko chhote hisson mein torna (Decomposition), (3) step-by-step hal banana (algorithm), (4) hal ko jaanchna aur behtar karna (Evaluating and Improving Solutions).

blocks.prompt: Computational thinking se masla hal karne ke do faide likhein.
blocks.explanation: Masla logical aur tarteeb wale tareeqe se hal hota hai, aur ghaltiyan aur uljhan kam hoti hain. Is se masla hal karne ki majmooi salahiyat bhi behtar hoti hai.

items: 2.2: computational thinking masle logical aur organized tareeqe se hal karwati hai.
Ghaltiyan aur confusion kam; masla hal karne ki salahiyat behtar.
Computer bhi isi tarah masle hal karte hain, magar bohat tez.
